label: FOUND
role: Merges 11 FP32 split partials per request into the BF16 decode attention output; 78 calls per decode step.
pcvs: w (requests) 1..4, splits per request (2,3,5,8,11 and the real FlashMLA schedules), wsplits = total splits
finding: Learned interface (original): global_read_bytes = 16384*w + 131328*wsplits, blocks = 8*w, sum_launch_max_block_lane_sequence_span = 29*splits + 253. The combine is launched for 64 padded heads although only 32 are consumed, sizes its LSE loop from 48 launched parts (MAX_SPLITS 64) instead of the 11 actual splits, and one warp per head walks the splits with a prefetch-depth-1 loop. Latency model (v1): modeled critical path 5749 with 12 exposed global loads (11 split-loop waits).
fix: Wide combine (gen-glm53-decode-step branch flashmla-combine-trim b1833846, combine_glm53.cuh): 32 heads, MAX_SPLITS from a host replica of the scheduler, 4 warps per head with all split loads issued up front. DrPerf: bitwise-equal output and LSE on 1920 (request, head) rows incl. the real schedules; unique reads/writes halved; span 7*splits+238; latency model path 2033 with 2 exposed loads.
fix_status: Merge-ready (token-exact on GPU); not yet in a serving build.
timing: B300 decode harness w4: uniform 15.74 -> 15.44 ms, hot 14.22 -> 13.93 ms (-0.29..-0.31 ms/step); combine 9.0 -> 5.6 us/call (CUPTI). Token-exact vs control in every matched run.
credit: Padding and split sizing: DrPerf interface. Serial load chain: first read from source, now flagged by the latency model. Ranking: CUPTI timeline.
